subject: maths
question: A bus runs at a speed of 70 km/h. What distance will it cover in 36 minutes?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed = 70 km/h,

Time = 36 minutes

**Concept Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

Convert minutes to hours:

36 minutes = 36/60 hours = 0.6 hours

⇒ Distance = 70 km/h × 0.6 hours

⇒ Distance = 42 km

**The bus will cover 42 km in 36 minutes.**
